changelog: Connecting Beatra is smoother: the helper waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.

en.description: Turn a written visitor reception script into one visitor reception voice clip per labeled cue. This front desk voice studio records each cue the desk already wrote, from reception script audio to visitor greeting voice lines, and delivers 8 to 20 clips as one visitor desk voice pack. Use it for visitor reception voice packs that keep one cue on each clip.
en.summary: Turn a written visitor reception script into one visitor reception voice clip per labeled cue.
en.title: Visitor Desk Voice: Reception Script Clips
